title: Catalpol attenuates postmenopausal osteoporosis by activating SIRT1-mediated P53 deacetylation and inhibiting CASPASE-3-driven osteoblast apoptosis.
authors: Bian, Yishan; Wang, Qilan; Liang, Qixing; Zhu, Yuzhe; Wu, Chengliang; Ruan, Hongfeng; Hu, Xueqin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物梓醇通过SIRT1-P53通路抗骨质疏松的机制，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法聚焦于TF-DNA结合，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Postmenopausal osteoporosis (PMOP) is primarily characterized by a disruption in the balance between bone formation and resorption, predominantly due to osteoblast apoptosis induced by estrogen deficiency. Sirtuin 1 (SIRT1), a pivotal deacetylase known for inhibiting P53-mediated apoptosis, is observed to be downregulated in PMOP. Catalpol (CAT), an iridoid glycoside derived from Rehmannia glutinosa, has demonstrated antiapoptotic and antioxidative properties; however, its potential role in modulating the SIRT1-P53 signaling pathway in the context of PMOP remains to be elucidated. METHODS: Utilizing a network pharmacology approach, SIRT1 was identified as a central target of CAT in the context of PMOP, a finding further substantiated through molecular docking and 100-ns molecular dynamics simulations. To validate this proposed mechanism, ovariectomized (OVX) mice were administered CAT with or without the SIRT1 inhibitor EX527. Bone mass, strength, and remodeling were assessed using micro-computed tomography (micro-CT), three-point bending tests, enzyme-linked immunosorbent assays (ELISA) for procollagen type I N-terminal propeptide (P1NP) and C-terminal telopeptide of type I collagen (CTXI), and immunohistochemical analysis. In vitro, hydrogen peroxide (H(2)O(2))-induced MC3T3-E1 cell models were employed to evaluate osteoblast differentiation and apoptosis via alkaline phosphatase (ALP) staining, flow cytometry, and Western blot analysis focusing on the SIRT1-P53-CASPASE-3 axis. RESULTS: Molecular docking and 100-ns MD predicted a plausible CAT-SIRT1 interface. In cells, CETSA showed ligand-induced thermal stabilization of SIRT1, supporting intracellular target engagement. In H(2)O(2)-challenged osteoblasts, CAT reduced P53 (Lys382) acetylation, cleaved CASPASE-3, and Annexin V-positive cells; these effects were attenuated by the SIRT1 inhibitor EX527. In ovariectomized mice, CAT improved trabecular microarchitecture on micro-CT and rebalanced bone turnover-increasing serum P1NP and decreasing CTX-I-with concomitant reductions in AcP53 and cleaved CASPASE-3 in bone. CONCLUSIONS: These findings support a SIRT1-centered mechanism whereby CAT engages SIRT1 in cells to restrain the P53-CASPASE-3 apoptotic program in osteoblasts and mitigate estrogen-deficiency bone loss in OVX mice.
abstract_zh: 背景：绝经后骨质疏松症（PMOP）的主要特征是骨形成与骨吸收之间平衡的破坏，这主要归因于雌激素缺乏诱导的成骨细胞凋亡。Sirtuin 1（SIRT1）是一种关键的脱乙酰酶，以抑制P53介导的凋亡而著称，在PMOP中观察到其表达下调。梓醇（Catalpol, CAT）是一种源自地黄（Rehmannia glutinosa）的环烯醚萜苷，已显示出抗凋亡和抗氧化特性；然而，其在PMOP背景下调节SIRT1-P53信号通路中的潜在作用仍有待阐明。方法：利用网络药理学方法，SIRT1被确定为CAT在PMOP背景下的核心靶点，这一发现通过分子对接和100纳秒分子动力学模拟进一步得到证实。为验证这一提出的机制，对去卵巢（OVX）小鼠给予CAT，联合或不联合SIRT1抑制剂EX527。使用显微计算机断层扫描（micro-CT）、三点弯曲试验、酶联免疫吸附试验（ELISA）检测I型前胶原N端前肽（P1NP）和I型胶原C端端肽（CTXI），以及免疫组织化学分析，评估骨量、骨强度和骨重塑。体外实验中，采用过氧化氢（H(2)O(2)）诱导的MC3T3-E1细胞模型，通过碱性磷酸酶（ALP）染色、流式细胞术和聚焦于SIRT1-P53-CASPASE-3轴的Western blot分析，评估成骨细胞分化和凋亡。结果：分子对接和100纳秒MD预测了合理的CAT-SIRT1界面。在细胞中，CETSA显示配体诱导的SIRT1热稳定性增强，支持细胞内靶点结合。在H(2)O(2)刺激的成骨细胞中，CAT降低了P53（Lys382）乙酰化、裂解的CASPASE-3和Annexin V阳性细胞；这些效应被SIRT1抑制剂EX527减弱。在去卵巢小鼠中，CAT改善了micro-CT上的骨小梁微结构，并重新平衡了骨转换——增加血清P1NP和降低CTX-I——同时伴随骨中AcP53和裂解的CASPASE-3的减少。结论：这些发现支持一种以SIRT1为中心的机制，即CAT在细胞中结合SIRT1，以抑制成骨细胞中的P53-CASPASE-3凋亡程序，并减轻OVX小鼠中雌激素缺乏引起的骨丢失。
